description: Defines the AccessToken class, representing an OAuth2 access token with methods for managing token data, expiration, and associated metadata.

classes.name: AccessToken
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 access token with capabilities to retrieve token info, check expiration, and serialize the token data.

methods.name: setTimeNow
methods.description: Sets the static current time, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: resetTimeNow
methods.description: Resets the static current time to null, restoring default time behavior.

methods.name: getTimeNow
methods.description: Returns the current time in seconds since epoch, or the overridden test time if set.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an AccessToken object from an options array, requiring 'access_token' and optionally setting expiration, refresh token, and resource owner ID.

methods.name: isExpirationTimestamp
methods.description: Determines whether a given value is an expiration timestamp or a duration in seconds.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Returns the expiration time as an integer.

methods.name: getResourceOwnerId
methods.description: Returns the resource owner ID associated with the token.

methods.name: hasExpired
methods.description: Checks whether the token has expired based on current time.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns additional token values captured during construction.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the token as a string representation.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the token data into an array suitable for JSON encoding.
